newsitem.title: DENMARK: FORECAST - Danish KFX index could fall 5-10 pct more.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST - Danish KFX index could fall 5-10 pct more.

text.p: Den Danske Bank, Denmark's biggest bank, said on Thursday it expected the Copenhagen Stock Exchange's top-20 KFX share index to fall by a further 5-10 percent as a result of the latest Wall Street declines.

"One could well envisage a further correction of between five and 10 percent in the KFX index, in all probability nearer five than 10 percent, before share prices look up again," Den Danske Bank senior executive vice president Mads Jacobsen told Reuters.
Jacobsen stressed though that he saw the falls as a reaction to recent hefty rises in stock prices in Denmark and that there was no sign of any looming market collapse.
"We are not seeing any market collapse looming. It is a process of correction we are experiencing and that process is not over yet," Jacobsen said.
"In no way do we face any financial crisis; we are just going through a rather sour period before we can again see share price rises," he added.
The top-20 KFX index was 2.63 percent or 4.01 point down from the start at 148.74 at 1215 gmt and dealers foresaw further falls before the close.
